Description: ComponentType includes specialty, but the PKG-02 canonical model Component.component_type enum does not. Specialty component records cannot be represented in the canonical model without a vocabulary change or explicit mapping.
ProposedDisposition: Reconcile specialty component vocabulary with DEL-02-01 before relying on specialty items in canonical or persisted model payloads. Stage 2 technical evidence: specialty is accepted in the current PKG-02 canonical component taxonomy, and tests/test_component_section_schema.py verifies the PKG-03 component enum against schemas/model.schema.yaml.

Description: Rigid/semi-rigid stiffness fields use ComponentQuantityDimension=stiffness, but PKG-02 units.schema.yaml DimensionId defines linear_stiffness and rotational_stiffness rather than generic stiffness. Dimensional checking for semi-rigid stiffness remains ambiguous.
ProposedDisposition: Define a governed stiffness dimension mapping or split stiffness fields into accepted linear/rotational dimensions before solver-facing use. Stage 2 technical evidence: generic ComponentQuantityDimension=stiffness was removed. Rigid/semi-rigid stiffness slots are represented as linear_stiffness and rotational_stiffness, with schema and strict fixture coverage.
